name: an empty or stub review is recorded as a review
expect: an empty review file is refused
a stub under the minimum length is refused

name: a review stating no verdict is recorded — the finding-less file is credited
expect: a review stating no verdict is refused — a finding-less file is a failed run

name: a review that never names the head is recorded against any head the coordinator types
expect: a review that never names the head it was handed is refused
a head named in prose but not on the first line is not declared

name: an abbreviated head counts as declaring it (r2: the first line carries the FULL sha)
expect: ...nor does an abbreviation, however long — the first line carries the FULL sha
a declaration of an ABBREVIATED head: refused as HEAD NOT NAMED, nothing written

name: a CODEX id is recorded here, testifying that a gate ran when nothing ran it
expect: a CODEX id is refused — its verdict is written by the wrapper that ran it
a Codex id through this door: refused

name: an existing verdict is overwritten
expect: an existing verdict is NOT overwritten

name: a head that is not a commit is recorded as typed
edits: return out if p.returncode == 0 and out else None
return out if p.returncode == 0 and out else head
expect: ...and says it is not a commit

name: the overlay is written as unknown, so the consumer cannot use the Claude verdict
expect: ...and the overlay it was GIVEN, here a clean one
check-review-recorded: a Claude verdict on the FINAL tree satisfies it

name: the head is recorded as the abbreviation typed, not the commit it resolved to
expect: ...under the FULL sha, though it was handed an abbreviation

name: the record says the gate did not run, so no consumer can use it
expect: ...says the gate ran
check-review-recorded: a Claude verdict on the FINAL tree satisfies it

name: the recorder writes a clean overlay it never observed — the r11 Blocking reopened (PR #457 r1 H1)
expect: a half handed an uncommitted fix is recorded WITH that fix in its overlay
...so a fix reviewed and then REVERTED does not pass the final-tree gate

name: a --head the tree is not at is recorded, because only the review text was checked (r1 M1)
expect: a head the tree is NOT at is refused, though the review names it

name: a first line declaring ANOTHER commit is accepted (r1 Codex High)
expect: ...and naming a DIFFERENT commit does not count as naming this one
...and the head is the one ASKED about: the same review against another head is refused
...and a first line naming the OTHER full sha is a HEAD MISMATCH

name: a prefixed or quoted first line counts as the declaration (r1 M1; r2 H1)
expect: a head named only inside a QUOTED line is refused
a declaration with a prefix: refused as HEAD NOT NAMED, nothing written
a declaration with anything after the sha: refused as HEAD NOT NAMED, nothing written

name: a declaration on ANY line counts — a comment, a lazy quote, a later line (r2 H1)
expect: ...an HTML comment in the declaration form too: refused as HEAD NOT NAMED, nothing written
...a lazy continuation in the declaration form too: refused as HEAD NOT NAMED, nothing written
...the declaration form anywhere BUT the first line is not declared

name: a verdict PREFIX reads as the verdict (r2 M3)
expect: ...nor on the declaration line
...nor with anything after the word

name: a verdict line ANYWHERE is the verdict — a fenced example or a comment (r2 M2)
edits: last = next((line for line in reversed(_lines(text)) if line.strip()), "")
last = next((line for line in _lines(text) if VERDICT_LINE.fullmatch(line)), "")
expect: ...and with the declaration form, the LAST line is the verdict, not the fenced example
...nor in the declaration form
...and a verdict line ABOVE the last line is not the verdict

name: a symlinked review or verdict path is followed (r1 L3, both halves)
expect: a review that is a SYMLINK is refused
a verdicts DIRECTORY that is a symlink is refused, and nothing is written there

name: the parsed verdict is not recorded
expect: ...and the verdict the review states
a NOT CONVERGED review is recorded as NOT CONVERGED

name: a Unicode line separator splits a line, so text Markdown renders on one line is read as two
expect: ...but a Unicode line separator does not make a new line
...but a Unicode line separator does not end the first line

name: the first line is read after the body is stripped, so a blank line 1 is skipped
expect: ...nor is the first line read after the body is stripped: line 1 is line 1
a declaration under a blank first line: refused as HEAD NOT NAMED, nothing written
